Implant Supported Dentures

Add Comfort and Security

Do you have dentures, or are you considering them? Clearwater Dental understands the challenges faced by denture wearers, from discomfort and instability to a weak bite and decreased confidence. These problems can have a significant impact on your quality of living. We are passionate about providing a revolutionary solution: implant-supported dental prostheses.


Dental implants can revolutionize your lifestyle and oral health. We can securely fix your dentures by strategically placing two dental implants. This will provide greater stability, a better bite and increased comfort during your daily activities. We can retrofit an existing denture or create a custom solution that snaps securely onto dental implants. This ensures long-term stability in your mouth. Implant-supported dentures stimulate the growth of jawbone. It not only helps to support the dentures, but it also reduces irritation or soreness of the gums which is often associated with traditional dentures. You can enjoy more foods and engage in social activities with implant-supported dentures.

Why Choose Implant Supported Dentures

Dentures are not the best option for replacing missing teeth permanently. Dental implants provide a superior alternative. Dental implants not only give you a natural smile, but they also work like real teeth! You must maintain good oral hygiene, such as brushing, flossing, and maintaining the gums, just like with natural teeth. However, your implants will not cause you any discomfort or cavities!

﻿

Furthermore, dental implants provide several advantages over traditional dentures. Implants are anchored securely into the jawbone and provide stability, preventing embarrassing moments when eating or speaking. This stability allows you to chew more naturally, which will allow you to eat a variety of food without restriction.

  • Read More

    Dental implants also contribute to maintaining the jawbone's structure. The jawbone may deteriorate due to lack stimulation when teeth are missing. Implants stimulate the jawbone, preventing bone loss. It not only helps maintain facial aesthetics, but also promotes overall oral health.


    You can expect your implants, bridges and dentures to last the rest of their lives with proper care, regular checkups at our office, and regular maintenance. Our team will provide you with personalized care to ensure that your dental restorations are functional and long-lasting. Dental implants are not only a long-term investment, but they also provide you with comfort, confidence and a beautiful, healthy smile.


    Do not hesitate to discover the benefits of dental implant restoration and improve your quality of life. Call us to schedule a consultation and begin your journey towards a healthier, happier, and more confident life.

Full-Scope Implant care In-House

If you currently wear dentures or anticipate needing them in the future, implant-supported dentures could be beneficial to you. At Clearwater Dentist, our knowledgeable team can guide you through each stage of the implant and full-arch solution process; similar steps apply when receiving implant-supported dentures as with individual dental implants.

 

After extracting any remaining teeth, bone grafting may be necessary to restore proper jaw volume. Our team then expertly places implants into your jaw. Once secure, we adapt a denture appliance so your denture will snap securely onto two to four implants at once, providing a secure hold.

 

Implant-supported dentures provide you with confidence to speak and eat with assurance knowing that they're securely fixed into place. Reach out to Clearwater Dentist now to explore how implant-supported dentures could enhance your quality of life!

Frequently Asked Questions

Is eating with implant-supported dentures safe?

Yes

How long do implant-supported dentures last?

Implant-supported dentures can vary widely in longevity. The biggest factor in how long they last is how closely the patient follows the prescribed cleaning schedule and home hygiene. With proper maintenance, implant-supported dentures can last a lifetime.

How are implant-supported dentures different from traditional dentures?

Yes, traditional dentures have to be removed and cleaned daily and kept out of the mouth at night. Implant-supported dentures 

How are implant-supported dentures different from traditional dentures?

Yes, traditional dentures have to be removed and cleaned daily and kept out of the mouth at night. Implant-supported dentures 

What is the difference between implant-supported dentures and implant-retained dentures?

Implant-supported dentures are removable, while implant-retained dentures are permanently attached to the implants. With implant-supported dentures, two or more implants are placed and the denture snaps on and off the implants. With implant-retained dentures, four or more implants are placed and the denture is permanently affixed to the implants. 

What are the pros and cons of implant-retained dentures?

The pros of implant-retained dentures is that it is permanently installed and allow for healthy function while eating. The cons are that it requires diligent and frequent cleaning that must be done in order to keep the implants from failing
